items.why: Caught in the chip-stock selloff as hot inflation revived Fed rate hike talk; AMD is off over 5% with Nov 3 earnings approaching after a 180% run this year.
Guggenheim lifted its 2027 AI capex estimate to $225B, per Barron's, reviving fears of an over-investment cycle around Muse and the Wonder models.
Sliding with chipmakers broadly as the Nasdaq fell, per Reuters, while hot inflation crushed hopes for rate cuts.
Sliding with the risk-off tape; BNP Paribas flagged cash-burn worries after Tesla guided 2026 capex above $25B, per Barron's.

market_note: Hot CPI revived talk of another Fed rate hike; VIX up, S&P futures down about 1%.
summary: Stocks are selling off midday Wednesday after a hot inflation report lifted yields and put another Fed rate hike back in play, with tech and chip names leading the decline.
